name: Risk Management EA Based on ATR Volatility
summary: This EA uses ATR (Average True Range) volatility to dynamically calculate position sizing and stop loss levels, adapting risk exposure to current market conditions. It enters trades when price action confirms a trend direction relative to ATR-based thresholds and manages exits through ATR-adjusted trailing stops. The core philosophy is that volatile markets require wider stops and smaller positions, while calm markets allow tighter stops and larger positions.
summary_zh: 该EA利用ATR（平均真实波幅）波动率动态计算仓位大小和止损水平，根据当前市场条件调整风险敞口。当价格走势相对于ATR阈值确认趋势方向时入场，并通过ATR调整的追踪止损管理出场。核心理念是波动大的市场需要更宽的止损和更小的仓位，而平静的市场允许更紧的止损和更大的仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于ATR波动率的自适应风险管理趋势跟踪系统。入场条件通常依赖价格突破ATR倍数定义的波动通道，当价格突破上轨做多、突破下轨做空，从而捕捉趋势启动点。出场条件采用ATR倍数作为止损和止盈依据，止损距离随市场波动率自动调整，避免在波动增大时被噪音止损。仓位管理是该EA的重点，通过将账户风险百分比除以ATR计算出的每点价值来动态确定手数，确保每笔交易的风险金额恒定。资金管理方面，EA会根据账户余额和设定的风险比例自动计算最优仓位，实现固定分数资金管理。整体策略在趋势市场中表现优异，但在震荡行情中可能产生较多假突破信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is an adaptive risk management trend-following system based on ATR volatility. Entry conditions typically rely on price breaking through an ATR-multiple-defined volatility channel, going long when price breaks above the upper band and short when breaking below the lower band, capturing trend initiation points. Exit conditions use ATR multiples for both stop loss and take profit, with stop distance automatically adjusting to market volatility to avoid being stopped out by noise during increased volatility. Position sizing is the key focus of this EA, dynamically determining lot size by dividing the account risk percentage by the per-point value calculated from ATR, ensuring a fixed monetary risk per trade. In terms of money management, the EA automatically calculates optimal position size based on account balance and the set risk percentage, implementing fixed-fractional money management. The overall strategy performs well in trending markets but may generate numerous false breakout signals in ranging conditions, leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 基于ATR的自适应仓位管理，根据市场波动率动态调整风险敞口，科学合理
止损距离随波动率自动调整，避免在波动增大时被噪音止损出场
固定分数资金管理确保每笔交易风险可控，不会因单笔亏损导致账户大幅回撤
追踪止损机制让盈利仓位跟随趋势运行，最大化趋势利润
参数化设计灵活，交易者可根据不同品种和市场环境调整ATR周期和倍数
pros_en: ATR-based adaptive position sizing dynamically adjusts risk exposure according to market volatility, providing a scientifically sound approach
Stop loss distance automatically adjusts with volatility, preventing premature stop-outs from noise during increased volatility periods
Fixed-fractional money management ensures controllable risk per trade, preventing significant account drawdowns from single losses
Trailing stop mechanism allows winning positions to ride trends, maximizing trend profit capture
Parameterized design offers flexibility for traders to adjust ATR period and multipliers for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续假突破信号，导致频繁止损
ATR指标具有滞后性，在市场波动率急剧变化时可能无法及时反映真实风险
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一时间框架的ATR信号可能产生误判
没有明确的交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
过度依赖单一指标(ATR)，缺少价格行为和趋势强度的综合判断
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to consecutive false breakout signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop-outs
ATR indicator has inherent lag and may fail to reflect true risk in real-time during sudden volatility spikes
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, relying on single-timeframe ATR signals which may produce misjudgments
No explicit trading session filter, potentially generating unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Over-reliance on a single indicator (ATR), lacking comprehensive judgment combining price action and trend strength
improvements: 增加多时间框架ATR确认和趋势方向过滤，例如使用日线ATR确定大趋势方向后再在小时图入场
加入波动率状态识别机制，在低波动震荡期自动降低仓位或暂停交易，减少假突破损失
增加交易时段过滤器，避开低流动性时段和重大新闻发布时间
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe ATR confirmation and trend direction filtering, such as using daily ATR to determine macro trend before entering on hourly chart
Implement volatility regime detection to automatically reduce position size or pause trading during low-volatility ranging periods, minimizing false breakout losses
Add trading session filter to avoid low-liquidity periods and major news release times

risk_points: ATR滞后性可能导致止损设置不够宽，在突发事件中仍可能遭受滑点损失
趋势跟踪在横盘震荡市中会产生连续小额亏损，需要足够资金承受回撤期
缺少最大回撤限制和日内亏损上限，极端情况下可能超出预期风险
risk_points_en: ATR lag may result in insufficiently wide stops, still exposing to slippage losses during sudden events
Trend following in sideways markets generates consecutive small losses, requiring sufficient capital to endure drawdown periods
Lacks maximum drawdown limit and daily loss cap, potentially exceeding expected risk in extreme scenarios
